verdict.rationale: Treg is an API/tool-proxy platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair axis, but its documentation shows only request/response proxying, a CLI and an MCP endpoint, with no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. A community commenter describes Treg as 'a set of stateless APIs' and says the stateful half (webhooks, signals, schedules) is where tools like Clay still have the edge. That points to absence of the feature rather than a contradicted claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
